zh: 修复 Windows 桌面端闪退：AI 运行的命令输出中文（GBK 编码）内容时程序会直接消失，现已修复，并顺带解决长输出被截断时出现乱码的问题。
移动端升级为原生液态玻璃架构：支持 iOS 与 Android 双端原生渲染，重构 100% 全宽平滑手势侧栏与紧凑版式。
优化对话渲染与流式响应：新增实时打字机流式刷新机制，修复会话重入重绘，全面提升移动端交互流畅度。
登录与网络自适应增强：解决登录页非滚动专业布局与空白处轻触收起键盘，强化多节点容灾与快速建连能力。
en: Fixed a Windows desktop crash: the app could vanish when a command run by the AI printed non-UTF-8 (GBK) output; truncated long output no longer turns into garbled text.
Mobile apps upgraded to native liquid glass architecture with full-screen gesture sidebar and compact responsive layout on iOS and Android.
Real-time streaming and chat rendering improved: added instant typewriter streaming updates and view refresh reliability.
Login and network resilience enhanced: fixed non-scrollable native login page, dismiss keyboard on background tap, and smart multi-node failover.
